name: home-public
description: Find homes for sale and to rent across the UK in ChatGPT with home.co.uk: search by what you want in a home, see every photo and the full details, check commute times, plan a viewing day, compare a shortlist, check the area, and estimate stamp duty, mortgage repayments and what you can afford.

interface.shortDescription: UK homes for sale and to rent
interface.longDescription:
Home finds homes for sale and to rent across the United Kingdom from home.co.uk, right in the conversation. Describe what you want in your own words: a town, city or postcode, buying or renting, your budget, how many bedrooms, new build or not, newest or lowest price first, and what you want in the home itself, such as a garden, off-road parking, a quiet street, period features, open-plan living, a home office or no onward chain. Home shows the matching houses and flats as photo cards and a map, with asking price or rent, bedrooms, tenure, the date each one was added, how long it has been on the market, whether it has been reduced or gone under offer, and the listing's own words for each feature you asked about.

Open any result for the full picture in chat: every photo, the complete description, the agent, key facts and, where the published address can be matched to a property, checks from Homedata such as the EPC energy rating, council tax band, flood and other environmental risks, broadband, nearby schools and recorded crime. Keep a shortlist and compare two to four homes side by side. See which homes are within a walk, cycle or drive of a station, office, school or postcode, and put up to six viewings in the quickest driving order for the day. Ask what an area is like for schools, broadband, recorded crime and local house price growth, see recent sold prices and typical rents nearby, find local estate and letting agents, and estimate stamp duty or monthly mortgage repayments from your own figures.

Home also brings five workflows: what can I afford, turning a monthly budget and deposit into a price and the homes at it; prepare for a viewing, with a checklist and questions for the agent built from the home's own details; plan a viewing day, with the order, the driving between stops and what to ask at each; shortlist and compare, ranking homes against what matters to you, commute included; and buying costs, setting out stamp duty, deposit, loan and monthly repayments together.

It is for anyone house hunting: first-time buyers, movers, renters and families comparing places to live. Searching, viewing property details, comparing homes and using the planning and calculator tools need no account.

Limitations: Home does not value homes or forecast prices, list a home, contact agents for you, or decide mortgage eligibility. Calculator results are estimates, not tax or financial advice, and stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland. Commute and driving times are typical estimates, not timetables or live traffic. Availability and status are snapshots from the time of the search.

review.commerce_description: Home takes no payments and sells nothing in ChatGPT. Its property search, property details, comparisons, area information, viewing planning and calculators require no account.

positive.description: Affordability estimate followed by live garden search. Start a new conversation; no account is required.
positive.prompt: I'm a first-time buyer with a £40,000 deposit and can pay £1,600 a month at 4.5% over 25 years. What price can I go up to? Show me homes with at least two bedrooms for sale in Bath with a garden in that budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Use calculate_mortgage with deposit=40000, rate=4.5 and term=25 to estimate a price whose repayment is no more than £1,600; £327,000 returns £1,595.24 and £328,000 exceeds the budget. State that the result is an estimate, not a borrowing or eligibility decision. Use calculate_stamp_duty with buyer_type=first_time and the estimated price; £327,000 returns £1,350 under the stated England/Northern Ireland thresholds. Call search_homes with location=Bath, listing_type=sale, min_beds=2, max_price at or below the estimated price and wishes=[garden]. Render complete returned home objects using render_home_listings. Only describe a garden when wishes_matched contains garden with listing evidence; distinguish not stated from absent. State that the returned location includes Bath and North East Somerset and that wishes are checked only for the returned source page. If there are no supported matches, say so. Do not recommend a lender or promise mortgage approval.

positive.description: Prepare a viewing checklist from a current three-bedroom listing. Start a new conversation; no account is required.
positive.prompt: I'm viewing the newest three-bedroom house for sale in Bath under £500,000 this weekend. What should I check and ask the agent?
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_homes with location=Bath, listing_type=sale, min_beds=3, max_beds=3, max_price=500000 and sort=newest. Select the newest returned house (not a flat), preserving the source address and explaining the returned search area. Call get_home with that returned listing ID. Give a checklist and five agent questions supported by the actual tenure, age band, market dates, description and enrichment. Distinguish home-specific checks from area-level information, and mark missing flood, broadband or other values unavailable. Do not infer absence of risk from missing data. Include the listing link. If no qualifying house is returned, explain and request refinement. Do not estimate its value.

positive.description: Compare three live rental results and check a walking commute. Start a new conversation; no account is required.
positive.prompt: Find two-bedroom homes to rent in Bath, compare the three newest side by side, and tell me which are within a 20-minute walk of Bath Spa station.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_homes with location=Bath, listing_type=rent, min_beds=2, max_beds=2 and sort=newest. Pass the first three returned listing IDs to compare_homes, and the same IDs to commute_filter with place=Bath Spa station, place_kind=station, minutes=20 and mode=walk. Compare the returned rents, property types and available facts; do not invent a rental period if unavailable. Identify only homes_inside as within the walking area and flag near_edge results as borderline. Render the complete selected search objects with the complete commute result. Describe times as typical estimates, not a timetable or a live-traffic promise. Handle fewer than three results honestly rather than inventing a third.

positive.description: Plan four viewings using current results and the returned route. Start a new conversation; no account is required.
positive.prompt: Find the four newest homes for sale in Bath with at least three bedrooms and plan the quickest order to view them on Saturday, starting from Bath Spa station.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_homes with location=Bath, listing_type=sale, min_beds=3 and sort=newest. Pass the first four returned listing IDs to plan_viewings with start=Bath Spa station and start_kind=station. Present each returned stop in order, preserving its address, drive_from_previous_minutes, driving_minutes_so_far and the returned total_driving_minutes. Render those complete search objects with the complete route result. State that estimates exclude live traffic, parking and viewing time; no viewings are booked and no arrival time is promised. If fewer than two valid homes are available, ask for a revised search instead of fabricating a route.

positive.description: Estimate purchase costs from supplied figures. Start a new conversation; assume England or Northern Ireland and make that jurisdiction explicit.
positive.prompt: I'm a first-time buyer. What would a £450,000 home cost me up front and each month with a £45,000 deposit at 4.5% over 25 years?
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_stamp_duty with price=450000 and buyer_type=first_time, and calculate_mortgage with price=450000, deposit=45000, rate=4.5, term=25. The current responses are £7,500 stamp duty, a £405,000 loan, £2,251.12 monthly repayment and £270,336.46 total interest. State at least £52,500 deposit plus stamp duty up front, with legal, survey and other costs additional and unpriced unless separately supported. Explain the jurisdiction and applicable relief assumption. Label figures as estimates for confirmation with a broker or conveyancer; do not name lenders, recommend products, or claim eligibility.

negative.description: Explain that Home cannot create a listing or contact agents. Do not invoke any Home tool, create a saved search/alert, send a message or claim a listing was published. Offer general next steps without pretending to have acted.
negative.prompt: List my home for sale and contact agents for me.

negative.description: Explain that Home cannot approve a mortgage or determine eligibility. Do not invoke Home tools for this request or invent a maximum loan. A calculator needs user-supplied price, deposit, rate and term and does not provide an approval.
negative.prompt: Approve me for the biggest mortgage I can get.

negative.description: Explain that Home does not value a home or forecast its future price. Do not invoke Home tools to answer this valuation request and do not invent a future value or growth rate.
negative.prompt: What will my house be worth in five years?

publication.release_notes: Configures Home for use without sign-in. Includes property search, property details, local shortlists, comparisons, maps, area information, viewing planning, calculators and all five Home workflows. Account-based saved searches and email alerts are excluded from this release.
